##### Input:
- 1 Green stacked belt of Yumako  (At least half-full)
- 1 Green stacked belt of Jellynut (At least half-full)
- Calcite
- Water

##### Output:
- Legendary stack inserters 

The factory takes care of everything, including power, nutrients, seeds management, and rockets to send the inserters to space


##### How to start:
- Connect inputs
- Put 1000 spoilage in the nutrients area (bottom left)
- Put initial fuel until you've got power
- 50 logistics bots

##### Quality Items:

Can the quality items in the blueprint be replaced with lower tier quality? The answer is "it won't be that trivial":
- Legendary biochambers can be replaced with common biochambers. You will have to replace the productivity modules with speed modules in that case to match the requirements, and it will use much more fruits
- Assemblers and EM Planets can be replaced with lower quality items, but it will make everything much slower
- Beacons can be replace with common beacons - it will make everything slower, and ALSO it means you need more power as lower tier beacon uses much more electricity. 
- Heat Towers with lower quality WILL make the factory to be flooded with spoilage.
- Lower quality for steam turbines means that you need to connect the factory to extrenal power as it won't be enough
- Lower quality recyclers will make the factory to be flooded. You can remove one of the common stack inserter assembler to lower the production and avoid that

#### Updates
- **14/Feb/2026:** Bug fixes
- **10/Nov/2025:** Small fix for a possible deadlock in the sulferic acid production module.
title: Legendary Stack Inserter from Fruits
